results.title: Record delegations but publish no band
results.evidence: a 1 USD ceiling signed off a 250,000,000 exposure because no band is published: `refuse_beyond_delegation` runs only inside `if approval.get('band')`, and nothing in the estate view says the recorded ceilings are deciding nothing

results.title: The assessment is a reading, never a determination
results.evidence: 5 questions, each naming the words it turned on, and the proposal untouched

results.title: One bad row does not stop the batch
A baselined record is not a draft
results.evidence: baselined: imported from an existing estate; governed going forward, carrying explicit debt

results.title: Every baselined model carries its debt
Sign a tier 3 version while holding no delegation
results.evidence: a tier 3 version is approved without a delegation: the check lives in the quorum signing path and a tier 3 version never enters it. Pinned as a known edge

results.title: Signer holds no live delegation while others do
Delegation expiring in one second
results.evidence: live with a second left, not live five seconds later

results.title: Delegation recorded for `person/j.okafor`, signer authenticates as `j.okafor`
results.evidence: a delegation recorded for 'person/risk' grants nothing to the principal who authenticates as 'risk': `held_by` matches the principal column as a STRING, so the two spellings of one human are two people. The register writes owners in the prefixed form, so this is the spelling a firm will use

results.title: Delegation in JPY against a USD-read exposure
Two delegations, one JPY one USD
results.evidence: the comparable ceiling decides and the JPY row is ignored

results.title: Two USD delegations of different sizes
results.evidence: the larger of two live ceilings decides

results.title: Exposure exactly equal to the ceiling
results.evidence: an exposure of exactly 250,000,000 is within the ceiling
